name: oscar
description: OSCAR: free, open-source control surfaces for OSC, MIDI and DMX on any phone or tablet, designed in the browser, no app on the phone. This plugin: a skill to design interfaces for Resolume, TouchDesigner, QLab, DAWs and lights, A skill for the design and the wire, and OSCAR's read-and-draft MCP server. Never sends to a rig.
